Patellar subluxation/dislocation
The kneecap can be forced out of its groove by the non-contact twisting motions or direct blows that occur in basketball.

Repetitive stress from jumping in basketball can cause micro-tears and inflammation of the patellar tendon, presenting as an acute-on-chronic injury.
